images.name: C5
images.prompt: Cinematic film still, photorealistic, NASA-style deep space photograph. The planet Earth seen from very far away as one tiny glowing pale blue dot on the right third of the frame, the rest a vast black starfield with faint Milky Way haze, a thin sunbeam of light crossing the frame. No people, no spacecraft. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks.
